author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
HeroScape is back with their most recent branded offer for their entry-level tabletop skirmish game! Joes and Cobra take to the field in both premium pre-painted and unpainted sets with snap-together terrain. Miss the eighties? This is for you. Let's check it out!

Available for Pre-Order HERE: https://renegadegamestudios.com/heroscape/g-i-joe/?srsltid=AfmBOoqR3RaihROPdXSv3Fdas89wpoi6y-sr1YDJev--yqqBINx0KYUl
